scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @multiview/api build && pnpm --filter @multiview/worker build && pnpm --filter @multiview/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @multiview/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @multiview/worker typecheck && pnpm --filter @multiview/web typecheck
